# EveryDev.ai

> With AI, Everyone is a Dev. Discover, review, and discuss AI tools with the community.

EveryDev.ai is the social network for AI developers. Join thousands of builders who share projects, review tools, and discuss AI development daily.

## Featured: Tools Arena & Compare Tools

Two flagship features for picking the right AI tool with confidence:

- [Tools Arena](https://www.everydev.ai/tools/arena): Ask a hard tool question in plain English. Two AI models search our tools database and answer side-by-side, then the community votes on the more useful response. Great for open-ended questions like "what's the best coding agent for a monorepo?" or "which vector DB should I use for RAG at scale?".
- [Compare AI Tools](https://www.everydev.ai/tools/compare): Evaluate any two (or more) AI tools side-by-side on pricing, features, integrations, and community ratings. Includes curated head-to-head comparisons for the most-searched tool pairings, so you can decide faster without bouncing between marketing pages.

## Core Features

- AI Tools Directory with 2,100+ tools, community reviews, and ratings
- Tools Arena: AI-vs-AI answers on tool questions, voted by the community
- Side-by-side tool comparisons with pricing, features, and real user ratings
- Build showcases where developers share what they're building
- Community discussions on LLMs, RAG, agents, and AI workflows
- Weekly newsletter with curated AI developer news
- Topic-based navigation across AI/ML domains

## Sections

- [AI Tools Directory](https://www.everydev.ai/tools): Browse and review 2,100+ AI development tools
- [Tools Arena](https://www.everydev.ai/tools/arena): Ask tool questions and watch AI models answer side-by-side, community-voted
- [Compare AI Tools](https://www.everydev.ai/tools/compare): Side-by-side comparisons of AI tools across pricing, features, and ratings
- [Topics](https://www.everydev.ai/topics): Browse content by AI/ML topic
- [Developers](https://www.everydev.ai/developers): Connect with AI builders
- [Discussions](https://www.everydev.ai/discussions): Community conversations about AI development
- [News](https://www.everydev.ai/news): Latest AI developer news and updates
- [Podcasts](https://www.everydev.ai/podcasts): AI Podcasts for Developers, a searchable, filterable AI podcast feed with inline listening
- [Builds](https://www.everydev.ai/builds): Showcase projects built with AI tools
- [Learn](https://www.everydev.ai/learn): Educational content for AI developers
- [Newsletter](https://www.everydev.ai/newsletter): Weekly digest of AI developer insights

## Community & Social

EveryDev.ai is a social platform where AI developers share and engage with each other.

### Create Content

- [Ask an Arena Question](https://www.everydev.ai/create/arena): Pose a tool question and let two AI models answer side-by-side for the community to vote on
- [Share a Build](https://www.everydev.ai/create/build): Showcase projects you've built with AI tools
- [Start a Discussion](https://www.everydev.ai/create/discussion): Ask questions or share insights with the community
- [Write a Blog](https://www.everydev.ai/create/blog): Publish articles about AI development
- [Submit a Tool](https://www.everydev.ai/create/tool): Add an AI tool to our directory

### Reviews & Ratings

Every tool in the directory can be reviewed and rated by the community. Developers share hands-on experiences, pros/cons, and use cases — not marketing copy. Look for tools with high ratings and detailed reviews from real users.

### Discussions

Conversations happen at multiple levels:
- Tool discussions: Each tool has its own discussion thread where users share tips, ask questions, and troubleshoot
- Topic discussions: Browse conversations organized by AI/ML topics like coding assistants, agent frameworks, or MCP servers
- Developer profiles: Follow builders and see what they're working on

## For Tool Makers

- [Submit Your Tool](https://www.everydev.ai/tools/submit): Add your AI tool to our directory
- [Advertise](https://www.everydev.ai/advertise): Reach thousands of AI developers
